description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Improved Unarmed Strike, Bomb Style, Bomb Strength, BAB +10 or Monk 5th Level

Benefit: While in this style, when you strike a target with unarmed strikes while flanking, every 4th successful attack deals an explosion of fiery energy, dealing 5d6 points of fire damage to the target and all creatures within a 15-ft.-radius, a Reflex save for half damage. This is in addition to the damage the target takes from Bomb Style and is not multiplied on a critical hit. In addition, your fire resistance increases to 15.
